propositions: Pure single-pass evidence-based AC verification produces false-positive rejections when prepack evidence is incomplete; operator proposes testing a FILTER (PASS/ABSTAIN only) followed by narrowed agentic verifier on abstained criteria to eliminate false-reject risk by construction.

Prepack deterministic evidence assembly (symbol grep, file slices, referencing commits, test names) capped at 6KB per AC yields bimodal filter coverage: greppable artifacts achieve 80-90% PASS rate while runtime-outcome ACs rationally ABSTAIN.

Filter+fallback design achieves -26% input tokens overall and -46% on all-met real tickets versus pure-agentic baseline with zero false PASSes on adversarial planted-unmet criteria, making it cost-positive while maintaining safety.

Agentic verifier itself exhibits low-rate false-FAIL variance (e.g. failing 2 genuinely-met ACs alongside planted ones in one 0e68-adv run); filter narrows this risk surface but does not eliminate upstream agentic variance.

Ticket descriptions exceeding 8000 chars trigger deterministic fast-FAIL in verify_completion; productization must re-check the cap after AC-block reduction and handle length-neutral adversarial edits.

Filter judgment stability is context-sensitive (same evidence pack yielded different PASS/ABSTAIN outcomes across ticket variants at temp 0); coverage telemetry per AC style is necessary to decide when filter call is worth making.
